title: Version Memory
description: Capture checkpoints, compare structural drift, and restore with a backup checkpoint created automatically.

hero.title: A version screen that tells you what changed, what stayed, and what will be kept.
hero.description: Each checkpoint stores a full project snapshot. Restores create a backup on the same branch first, then roll the project back to the selected state.
hero.calloutDescription: Use the branch panel to understand retention, the compare controls to inspect drift, and the version feed to jump directly to a checkpoint or restore target.

summary.totalVersionsHint: All checkpoints currently retained in the project.
summary.branchesHint: Version streams currently present in the ledger.
summary.branchSnapshotsHint: Branches whose latest checkpoint has a stored snapshot.
summary.detachedBranchesHint: Non-main streams currently present in the ledger.
summary.retentionHint: Only the latest three checkpoints per branch are kept.

create.title: Create checkpoint
create.description: Record the current project state on a branch.
create.label: Label
create.note: The snapshot is captured from the live project state before the record is written.

compare.title: Compare checkpoints
compare.description: Select any two stored snapshots and inspect their drift.
compare.helper: Compare works across branches, not only within one stream.
compare.emptyDescription: Choose two different checkpoints and run the comparison.

branches.title: Branch overview
branches.description: See what each branch currently retains.
branches.orphanAlertDescription: A detached branch with a single checkpoint may indicate an abandoned or incomplete line of work.

retention.description: Why old checkpoints disappear from the feed.
retention.alertDescription: When a branch grows beyond {{count}} checkpoints, the oldest entries are removed and the latest snapshots remain accessible.

history.title: Version feed
